observations: The mismatched projection-depth problem that let the sea draw over the new shelter floor is no longer visible in the final mobile shelter capture.
Normal public mobile entry displays the Day indicator, compact objective, joystick and contextual buttons without the old workbench panel covering the view.
The nearshore wave expression still has an angular wall/step appearance and insufficient natural detail.
Shelter walls and bedding remain coarse authored geometry; this is not accepted Palau cave morphology or final material quality.
Fish and birds remain shape/motion candidates, not verified species or final anatomical implementations.
scope: Shareable first playable chapter for interaction review; not a full six-month survival game or completed KAOPU world-system validation.
